Chapter 1235: Chapter 40: The Struggle Concludes (End of This Volume, Please Subscribe)

Outside the capital of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, a woman wearing a jade-green dress appeared.

"It’s been a long time since I’ve been here."

The woman in the jade-green dress looked at the vast city in the distance and smiled slightly.

Her name was Fu Ying Venerable, one of the oldest venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country, and she came to the capital of Fierce Sun to negotiate with Lin Yuan on behalf of the Da Fu Ancient Country.

"The Galaxy Venerate, the first core royal to excavate the ancestor’s bloodline to the venerable level..." Fu Ying Venerable’s mind flashed with intelligence about the Galaxy Venerate.

Before coming, she had repeatedly watched images related to the Galaxy Venerate, especially the battle in the treasured land where he repelled many peak venerables single-handedly.

"When negotiating with the Galaxy Venerate, one must lower their posture."

Fu Ying Venerable reminded herself inwardly.

As the strongest venerable in the Da Fu Ancient Country, facing strong peer-level opponents from other ancient countries always carried a sense of superiority.

This pride comes from being the first descendant of this world’s ancestors, and as the strongest venerable in the Da Fu Ancient Country, her power indeed surpasses that of the other ancient country’s strongest venerables.

But when facing the Galaxy Venerate?

Fu Ying Venerable was not foolish; naturally, she dared not bear any arrogance.

...

The moment Fu Ying Venerable, the strongest venerable of the Da Fu Ancient Country, entered the capital.

Deep within the palace, the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was aware.

The capital of Fierce Sun Ancient Country is a mystical artifact, refined by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, and all beings entering the capital are monitored, especially the strongest venerables of various ancient countries.

"Fu Ying Venerable... merely an avatar, no threat, must be going to find the Galaxy one."

The emperor of Fierce Sun glanced over but did not interfere.

In the past one or two hundred years, strong figures from the five ancient countries often sought out the Galaxy Venerate, attempting to negotiate and trade.

As for the content of the negotiations and trades... naturally, it was to redeem their own hidden killing artifacts, which can be used but must never fall into external hands.

"Tsk tsk, the attitudes of these strongest venerables..."

A smile appeared on the emperor’s face; how arrogant the strongest venerables of the ancient countries used to be? Even facing an emperor of an ancient country like him, they never showed much respect.

But now?

...

Inside the Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and looked outside the mansion, where a woman wearing a jade-green dress was smiling and standing.

"Fu Ying Venerable?"

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred and drew her in.

As the strongest venerable of the Da Fu Ancient Country, Lin Yuan naturally would not ignore.

The most crucial point is that Fu Ying Venerable’s visit must be to bring him treasures.

"I’ve long heard of the Galaxy Venerate."

Fu Ying Venerable smiled warmly, carefully sizing up Lin Yuan.

She knew the Galaxy Venerate in front of her was merely an avatar, but even from the avatar, one could gauge the hidden details and perceive certain information.

"This Galaxy Venerate, even his conjured avatar feels so real, it actually brings me a sense of threat..." Fu Ying Venerable’s heart trembled.

...

"What brings Fu Ying Venerable here?" Lin Yuan and Fu Ying Venerable sat opposite each other, asking casually.

Lin Yuan had some guesses about Fu Ying Venerable’s intentions, yet he still asked more.

"The Galaxy Venerate was magnificent in the treasured land, even Fu Xu fell." Fu Ying Venerable sighed: "I suppose some of the hidden killing artifacts from my Da Fu Ancient Country have fallen into your hands."

"There are indeed some, not only from your Da Fu Ancient Country." Lin Yuan looked at Fu Ying Venerable.

"Hmm." Fu Ying Venerable sighed inwardly, aware that this time she might have to bleed heavily.

Lin Yuan mentioning other ancient countries implied that strong figures from other ancient countries had already come; hence, with the conditions set by these ancient countries as a reference, retrieving the hidden killing artifacts from her own ancient country likely won’t be easy.

"Then I’ll be direct."

Without intending to beat around the bush, Fu Ying Venerable looked at Lin Yuan: "The hidden killing artifacts of my Da Fu Ancient Country cannot be allowed to spread outside, name your price, what will it take to return those artifacts."

"To exchange for those hidden killing artifacts..." Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

"Those hidden killing artifacts are useless to you; no one but my Da Fu Ancient Country’s experts can activate them." Fu Ying Venerable couldn’t help but remind him.

"I indeed can’t activate them." Lin Yuan nodded: "But I can collect them. After all, there probably aren’t that many hidden killing artifacts of the Da Fu floating outside?"

These words brought about.

Fu Ying Venerable’s expression shifted slightly.

This is precisely what she feared most.

"Galaxy Venerate, name your conditions." Fu Ying Venerable said helplessly.

Lin Yuan looked at her with a smile: "I want one hundred catties of Dragon Abyss Blood."

When Fu Ying Venerable heard this, her expression turned ugly: "Dragon Abyss Blood produced by Dragon Abyss Valley?"

"Yes, I want one hundred catties." Lin Yuan said.

Dragon Abyss Valley, a first-class treasured land controlled by the Da Fu Ancient Country, is said to be the burial place of the first life upon this world’s inception, with its blood spilling over Dragon Abyss. Life within Dragon Abyss Valley inherently carries some Dragon Abyss Blood.

The efficacy of Dragon Abyss Blood is vast, almost encompassing all aspects. It can nurture the body and nourish the soul, truly a supreme rare treasure among the six ancient countries.

However, creatures with Dragon Abyss Blood in their veins can only survive and thrive within Dragon Abyss Valley. Once they leave, the Dragon Abyss Blood within disappears and deteriorates.

This results in a very scarce output of Dragon Abyss Blood.

No one knows how many creatures in Dragon Abyss Valley it takes to purify just a drop of Dragon Essence Blood.

"Even for me, I only receive one drop of Dragon Abyss Blood every billion years, and you demand one hundred catties?" Fu Ying Venerable couldn’t help but exclaim.

As the strongest venerable, enjoying many privileges in the Da Fu Ancient Country, many special resources are directly allocated, including Dragon Abyss Blood.

But the amount of Dragon Abyss Blood allocated to Fu Ying Venerable is too small, merely a drop? One must realize, Dragon Abyss Blood is not heavy, weight akin to ordinary blood, a single drop of Dragon Abyss Blood is too light.

"Your Great Da Fu Ancient Country’s foundational weapon, how could it be comparable to Dragon Abyss Blood?" Lin Yuan said.

"Can it be slightly less?" Fu Ying Venerable communicated with other Strongest Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country before saying.

"A hundred pounds of Dragon Abyss Blood is useful to me, cannot be less." Lin Yuan shook his head.

Fu Ying Venerable fell silent, Lin Yuan did not rush him, knowing he was likely communicating with other Strongest Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country.

With Dragon Abyss Blood being a top-grade treasure controlled by Da Fu Ancient Country, its produced Dragon Abyss Blood rarely circulates to the other five Ancient Countries, typically consumed domestically, Lin Yuan only proposed such terms upon hearing of its preciousness.

"A hundred pounds of Dragon Abyss Blood is fine, but I have another condition." After a long time, Fu Ying Venerable looked at Lin Yuan and said.

He really agreed... Lin Yuan rejoiced internally and immediately said, "Please speak."

"Besides the foundational weapon, other treasures, weapons, and unique items of the Peak Venerables of my Da Fu Ancient Country, as well as those golden mists, must be returned to me."

Fu Ying Venerable said.

"You want those golden mists back?" Lin Yuan was aware of Fu Ying Venerable’s objective.

Those weapons combined aren’t worth a drop of Dragon Abyss Blood, Fu Ying Venerable specifically wants them back, most likely for the golden mists.

As a newly birthed precious treasure from the land, the golden mists hold high value, even if their specific effects and uses have not been thoroughly explored.

"No problem." Lin Yuan did not hesitate much and agreed directly.

Now that he controls the entire treasure land, the golden mists are endless and abundant.

Moreover, Lin Yuan intends to let some golden mists circulate out, thus he might leverage the strength of other Ancient Countries to discover the use of the golden mists.

This action can also elevate the value of the golden mists and increase many Venerables’ desire for them.

"Then the deal is reached."

Fu Ying Venerable nodded, "I will wait outside the treasure land for Galaxy Venerate to appear, bringing a hundred pounds of Dragon Abyss Blood."

Lin Yuan’s true self is still within the treasure land; to complete the transaction, he has to wait for the contest to end, for Lin Yuan to emerge, as only then can the foundational weapon be retrieved.

...

Inside the treasure land.

Lin Yuan continues to comprehend the Origin World’s Source within an irregular fissure, the time during which this Source is exposed is limited, only ten thousand years, Lin Yuan naturally cherishes it.

"Has the contest for the treasure land concluded?"

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something, split off an avatar and left.

At the treasure land’s exit.

Red Flame Venerable, Guanglie Venerable, and a group of Peak Venerables from Fierce Sun Ancient Country had long been waiting.

Two thousand years have passed, now the contest for the treasure land has ended, as for its ownership? Naturally, without suspense.

"Galaxy Venerate."

"Galaxy Venerate."

Upon seeing Lin Yuan appear, the Peak Venerables immediately greeted him.

"Mm."

"Let’s go out."

Lin Yuan nodded, simultaneously stepping out of the treasure land.

The eleven Peak Venerables of Fierce Sun Ancient Country also followed suit and stepped out.

...

Outside the treasure land.

All along, a group of Venerables awaited, all from various Ancient Countries.

These Venerables from other Ancient Countries saw Lin Yuan emerge, promptly came forward one after another, holding the promised unique treasures, exchanging for the foundational weapons and other spoils Lin Yuan seized from various Ancient Countries.

Very quickly.

The transaction was completed.

These Venerables also subsequently retreated.

"Galaxy Venerate, this treasure land now falls under your possession, though nominally belonging to Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

At this moment, a figure flew over, smiling at Lin Yuan.

"Mm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had discussed the matter regarding the treasure land with the emperor long ago.

"Galaxy Venerate, then we shall return for now."

Red Flame Venerable and a group of Peak Venerables from Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and said.

Now the treasure land is guarded by Lin Yuan, naturally these Peak Venerables have to return to the capital and report.

"Alright, if anything comes up, you can find me in the capital." Lin Yuan nodded.

He left an avatar in the capital, but his true self remains guarding within this treasure land, at least for ten thousand years, to closely observe the Origin World’s Source operation during this period, he won’t leave.

Very quickly.

Red Flame Venerable and numerous Peak Venerables left one by one.

Lin Yuan watched them go from afar, his thoughts turning.

"I wonder how much merit will be awarded to me for this contest over the treasure land."

Lin Yuan was quite envious of the many legacies within Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s treasury, especially the opportunity to merge with the Ancestor.

Such a chance to embody a thirteenth stage entity, observing life’s nuances from a temporal perspective, how precious could it be?

"Continue to comprehend."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts, his avatar directly dispersing, and his consciousness once again submerged into the observation of the Origin World’s Source operation.
